content.text:
Yes, this is really common at 20 months. Sudden night wakings often show up with big developmental leaps, teething, or a nap or bedtime that has drifted.

Tonight, if he wakes, keep it boring. Go in, use a calm low voice and a quick pat, and keep the lights off. Skip picking him up or starting a game, so 2am doesn't turn into something fun. If he's also running a fever or seems unwell, call 811.
